chars.SANAA: SANAA: a Moroccan woman, 30, long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey joggers
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a Moroccan man, 33, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a maroon polo shirt and beige chinos
chars.NOURA: NOURA: a young Moroccan woman, 24, straight black hair with a red headband, wearing a teal satin blouse and white jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modest Casablanca apartment living room: SANAA stands in the foreground with arms crossed, glaring angrily at KARIM and NOURA who sit close together on a low Moroccan sofa; KARIM looks back at her annoyed, NOURA looks smug. Open tension between them. Warm evening lamp light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan kitchen: SANAA loudly bangs pots on the stove with a defiant look, while in the doorway KARIM and NOURA argue with each other, irritated, hands raised. Domestic chaos.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small dark bedroom lit by moonlight through a window: SANAA lies in bed wide awake, eyes open staring at the ceiling, exhausted and anxious, blanket pulled up.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Dim small Moroccan room, SANAA sits alone on a floor cushion hugging her knees, half laughing half crying, tears on her cheeks, messy hair, a single lamp, lonely mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SANAA peeks through the narrow gap of a half-open door in a dark hallway, eyes narrowed with a revenge look, watching KARIM and NOURA laughing together in the lit living room beyond.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 3 a.m., dark small kitchen lit only by the open fridge light: SANAA stands alone in pyjama-like hoodie holding a glass of water, tired eyes, looking toward a closed bedroom door down the hall.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Dark hallway at night: SANAA presses her ear to a slightly open bedroom door, shocked; through the gap, in warm lamp light, NOURA whispers to KARIM while holding a small brown medicine bottle next to a drinking glass on the nightstand.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a dim bedroom lit by a bedside lamp: KARIM and NOURA sit on the edge of the bed leaning close, plotting in whispers with serious conspiratorial faces, a glass of water and a small medicine bottle on the nightstand between them.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Dark hallway, close-up of SANAA backing away from a door in terror, hand over her mouth, eyes wide with fear, cold blue night light.
